coverage.formula: coverage = measured / (measured + offBookEst); offBookEst = suppressedChecks + excusedElements × 12 (GROUP_CHECKS sum = checks per fully-measured element; conservative — the 5 unskippable per-element checks are not counted). thresholds.offBookCap: 70% (FAIL(off-book) unless reviewed in coverage-review.json with written reason + owner task)

gateFailures.threshold: < 40% measured (coverage floor — no escape; lift it with section work)

dark.note: spec is light-only: geometry/type re-asserted on the dark DOM; color group = token-flip census + contrast floor vs COMPOSITED effective background (rgba/oklch inks alpha-blended; uncountable pairs reported as skips)

edge390.tolerance: ±2px vs the spec's recorded 390 section-root gutter
